name: PDFMathTranslate
description: Translates scientific PDFs while keeping formulas, charts, table of contents and layout intact.
whatItDoes: Converts research papers into another language as translated or bilingual PDFs without breaking the page layout. It is for researchers and students reading foreign-language literature.
howItWorks: The tool analyses the page layout, separates text from formulas and figures, sends the text to a chosen translation service or LLM and writes it back into the original positions. It offers a command-line tool, a web UI in Docker and an MCP mode over stdio or SSE.

requirements.name: Translation service
requirements.description: Key for the chosen LLM or translation service, if it needs one

models: Multiple translation services and LLM providers
